name: ferrum-smoke
description: Ferrum smoke and integration suites: Playwright over CDP (adr-0031) against the app and the local HTTPS test server. npm run p2 (P2 regression), npm run p3 (P3 integration), npm test (all).

scripts.p3: playwright test tabs.spec shortcuts.spec startup.spec restore.spec profiles.spec history.spec downloads.spec responsive.spec no-freeze.spec settings.spec sidebar.spec bookmarks.spec address-search.spec backup.spec look.spec
scripts.p2: playwright test back-forward-refresh.spec loading-errors.spec redirects.spec new-windows-links.spec keep-cookies.spec google-sign-in.spec
